subject: LumenAI: Ops + Architecture workshop — scheduling & timezone alignment
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumenai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Ops + Architecture workshop — suggested windows and agenda

Hi Asha,

Really appreciated the discovery call yesterday — thank you for walking us through LumenAI's inference topology and the 3rd-party firewall constraints. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 90-minute Ops + Architecture workshop to: 

- validate network and IAM requirements
- walk through model serving topology (KV cache, batching, fallback routing)
- run a short checklist for telemetry & SLAs

Proposed time windows (PDT):
- Tue Oct 12, 09:00–10:30
- Wed Oct 13, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Oct 14, 16:00–17:30

Ben (solutions engineer) will lead the walkthrough; Marissa from Customer Onboarding will cover post-sales rollout. 

Prep items for a productive session:
1) A short network diagram (even a screenshot) showing where outbound connections can be opened (ports/egress).
2) Example load profile (qps and 99th pct tail latency targets).
3) Any compliance notes we should be aware of (data residency/HSM).

I attached an agenda draft and a runbook stub so you can see what we'll try to validate. If you prefer a different cadence (60-min focused workshop + follow-up breakout), we can adapt. 

Best,
Sofia
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda, 2 pages); runbook-stub.md (text)

From: Asha Rao <asha@lumenai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Suarez <diego.suarez@lumenai.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Ops + Architecture workshop — suggested windows and agenda

Thanks Sofia — that works. Quick notes:

1) Wed Oct 13 at 13:00 PDT (16:00 EDT) looks best for the core engineering group.
2) Diego will join for the network section and can share our firewall matrix.
3) We prefer the 90-min format to avoid extra handoffs.

Couple of asks from our side: will you need a service account or IP allowlist before the meeting? Also please confirm if recording is OK — we'll circulate internally.

Asha
Head of Platform
LumenAI

(On a schedule note, Diego is in Madrid — he indicated the 16:00 EDT slot keeps things reasonable.)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumenai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T12:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ops + Architecture workshop — suggested windows and agenda

Thanks Asha — Wed Oct 13 13:00 PDT / 16:00 EDT works for us.

Quick answers and a couple of tweaks:
- We do not need IP allowlist pre-meeting for the workshop — we'll demo against a staging endpoint. For a hands-on test later we'll request a short-lived IP or service account.
- Recording is fine; we'll upload to the shared Drive link in the prep folder.

Ben, do you mind owning the network walk-through? Can you also bring the list of optional telemetry hooks we recommend (tracing + token-level cost breakdown)?

Proposed final agenda (90 min):
0–10m: intros + goals
10–35m: serving topology & fallback routing (Ben)
35–55m: network/firewall walk-through (Diego + Ben)
55–75m: telemetry, SLA targets, and cost levers (Marissa)
75–90m: Q&A + action items

If all good, I'll send the calendar invite and attach the agenda + runbook.

—Sofia

Attachment references: redwood-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf; runbook-stub.md

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@lumenai.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ops + Architecture workshop — suggested windows and agenda

Hi all — I can take the serving topology and firewall section. A couple of prep notes from my side:

- If Diego can post the firewall matrix ahead of the meeting (ports, allowed FQDNs, and proxy/NAT behaviour) that will speed the session.
- I'll bring a short checklist (10 bullets) for KV cache sizing and burst behaviour.

I've attached the checklist as a stub. No more than 2 pages.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook-stub.md

From: Diego Suarez <diego.suarez@lumenai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@lumenai.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T23:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ops + Architecture workshop — suggested windows and agenda

Thanks — confirmed. Wed Oct 13, 13:00 PDT / 16:00 EDT; we'll join remotely from Madrid (CEST will be 22:00 for me; I confirmed with the team).

I uploaded the firewall matrix and a brief current-load sample to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-workshop-prep (files: lumenai-firewall-matrix.xlsx, lumenai-qps-sample.csv).

Attendees from LumenAI: Asha (Platform), Diego (Network), Priya Verma (SRE), Mark Chen (App Eng). Please include dial-in + Zoom link in the calendar invite and mark the meeting as recorded.

Diego
Principal Network Engineer
LumenAI
